proof_required: A buyer authorizes a real retrospective case and names a budget owner.
A baseline is measured before reconstruction.
The seller validates source lineage and amount positions remain separated.
An authorized processor response or a documented reason for no response is recorded.
A priced repeat is approved with a written artifact.
A second repeat uses the same workflow and has positive contribution margin after direct delivery costs.

objectives.measure: Staff minutes from source files received to a reviewed claim pack, compared with the same buyer's pre-pilot baseline.
objectives.pass_rule: Set and sign with the buyer before the pilot; do not use a generic benchmark.

objectives.measure: Claim value traceable to authorized source rows/pages; false-match count; seller-asserted, processor-confirmed, disputed and received amounts kept distinct.
objectives.pass_rule: No silent mapping or amount overwrite; unresolved source conflicts remain unresolved.

objectives.measure: Share of claim value with a recorded response, response time, reason code and later correction or cash allocation.
objectives.pass_rule: Report response and non-response separately; seller-only evidence is not buyer-confirmed.

objectives.measure: Written repeat price less measured direct onboarding, review, follow-up, support and infrastructure costs per counterparty-period.
objectives.pass_rule: A paid repeat needs a quote, purchase order, contract or decision email; the second repeat must have positive measured contribution margin.

objectives.measure: Unauthorized access or sharing, unresolved consent/mandate, data incidents, unsupported legal labels, and overdue retention/deletion actions.
objectives.pass_rule: Zero unresolved authority or cross-border transfer blockers before live personal data; any material incident pauses ingestion.

hard_constraints: No farmer subscription is assumed as the initial payer.
No Terravanta lending, factoring, custody of customer funds, payment initiation, credit decision or recovery guarantee without a separately reviewed legal and licensed-partner model.
No software-generated legal conclusion that a balance is due, overdue, recoverable or financeable.
No live claim evidence until the cooperative documents authority, purpose, access, retention, deletion and transfer safeguards.
No external model request for financial or personal data without explicit scoped authorization and approved terms.
Synthetic records and founder attestations never count as customer, market or revenue evidence.

action_rules.when: No named buyer, recurring claim problem or budget owner is verified.
action_rules.action: Interview cooperative claim owners, processor AP reviewers and financiers; do not add product features to compensate for missing demand.

action_rules.when: Source records exist but authority, data sharing terms or cross-border safeguards are incomplete.
action_rules.action: Pause live-data ingestion and resolve the legal/data-control gate before the pilot.

action_rules.when: A retrospective case has no baseline or has seller-only evidence.
action_rules.action: Measure the old workflow and label the claim as seller-asserted; do not call it confirmed or lender-ready.

action_rules.when: The processor does not respond or the financier will not rely on the pack.
action_rules.action: Record the reason and test whether the cooperative will pay for seller-side claim operations; do not claim a network or financing moat.

action_rules.when: The first paid repeat is absent or direct delivery cost exceeds its price.
action_rules.action: Do not scale integrations or infrastructure; narrow the service, change the payer/price hypothesis, or stop the wedge.

action_rules.when: Two repeats show positive margin and reuse the same mappings and review protocol.
action_rules.action: Productize the proven import/review steps and test the same workflow with a second cooperative/processor pair.
